title: Hodge-Carleman estimates and global attractors for heterogeneous elastic waves with localized damping on Riemannian manifolds
summary: We study the long-time dynamics of the semilinear Lamé system of isotropic elasticity on a compact Riemannian manifold with boundary, for a heterogeneous medium whose density and Lamé moduli vary in space, under a frictional dissipation which acts only on an open set $ω$. The elastic operator is the divergence of the Hooke stress tensor, and the starting point is a structural identity which shows that the dilatation and the vorticity of the displacement satisfy wave equations with the pressure and the shear speeds, respectively, coupled to the displacement only through first-order terms.
